newsitem.title: FRANCE: French police detain 10 Corsican nationalists.
newsitem.headline: French police detain 10 Corsican nationalists.

text.p: Police detained 10 members of a Corsican nationalist party on Wednesday as part of an investigation into links between bomb attacks and extortion on the French Mediterranean island, officials said.

The 10, seized in overnight raids in southern Corsica, were members of the Conculta Naziunalista party, the legal wing of the outlawed Corsican National Liberation Front - Historic Wing, the officials said.

Police say Corsican separatist groups seeking greater autonomy from France routinely finance their activities by demanding protection money, known locally as a "revolutionary tax", from local businesses, and bombing them if they fail to pay.
There are several hundred bomb attacks on Corsica each year, nearly all against property rather than individuals.
